findings.problem: The fix cannot be shown to pass or fail in VS Code, because the in-VS-Code suite was not allowed to run. The mutation checks I could do are static or toy: tsc on a scratch copy with api.ts reverted fails with TS2353 in host.ts and TS2339 in runs.test.ts, so the test depends on the new field. A scratch sim of the event order (sim.mjs) shows the unfixed filter lets the stale 'working' event satisfy the runId wait, while the fixed one does not. The orchestrator must rebuild dist/out (extension src changed) and re-run the smoke instance. If AT5.9 still fails after that, it will fail at a later assertion (canResume, hanging.sessions.length) or reveal a real recovery bug. In the failing run the restored RunManager was disposed mid-recovery (run.json shows step 'running', no 'recovered' transcript line), so the recovery path was never observed to completion in the extension host. The runner suites session.reload and manager.lifecycle cover it, and the code reads correctly (dispose sets interrupted and canResume; recoverSession keeps a working or interrupted active step interrupted).

The skipped test 'reload while a question waits' still has the old pattern (disposeWorkspace, then latestRun = undefined, then a runId wait) with the same latent race. It is skipped, so it is harmless now, but it would need windowGoes-style retirement if it is ever re-enabled.

The new `panel` field on BoardPostEvent (test API) and the retired-panel approach are not logged yet. The orchestrator should add them under 'Decisions for the orchestrator to log'. docs/project-report-files.md lists BoardPostEvent only by name, so nothing there is wrong.

summary: The fix is correct and complete for the failure, and I found no blocker or major issue. The root cause (a test race) is confirmed by the host log. At 30.749 the board closed, and at 30.765 run, session and notice were reported 'delivered' for the old 'working' view (updatedAt 30.722). The test had already reset latestRun, and the restore began at 30.790. So waitFor(runId === working.runId) was satisfied by the stale event, and the assert saw 'working'. The failed run's persisted run.json confirms the product wrote the right state: version 2, view.state 'interrupted', canResume true, the notice 'The editor closed while Claude was working.', and sessionId set. The source change is small: BoardPostEvent, the BoardPanel onPost dep and host.ts now carry the panel, and the test's windowGoes() retires the old panel before disposeWorkspace and then clears latestRun and latestSession. Callers: onPost has one implementer and one call site. The only other test touching this pattern is a skipped test in e2e-runs.test.ts. The webview is not involved. The restored board only posts its run after `runs.recovered`, in BoardPanel.attach and publishRuns, so the new wait cannot be satisfied by anything except the restored board. The retired set cannot hide the restored board's events, because the restored panel is fresh and is never retired by AT5.8 or AT5.9. Re-run: tsc --noEmit for packages/extension rc=0 (on the repo and on the scratch copy), and extension vitest with --no-cache, one worker and fsModuleCachePath in scratch gives 'Test Files 22 passed (22); Tests 216 passed (216)'. I did not re-run the runner suites, since runner source is not part of this fix. No repo file was edited; all mutations and the sim ran on a scratch copy at /tmp/claude-1002/-home-zhengyew-telelean/c398a83b-d60f-46a4-ad9a-8d926e6fdd1b/scratchpad/vscheck_at59/, and cmp confirmed the restored copies matched byte for byte."
